task.title: Design daemon job and run state model
task.summary: Define durable daemon job/run state for execution attempts, heartbeats, retries, block reasons, build/validation refs, and handoff metadata without replacing roadmap truth.

goal.outcome: Daemon jobs/runs have an approved schema, storage boundary, and lifecycle contract.
acceptance: Job/run states and transitions are specified.
Storage path and relationship to session queue/artifact status are specified.

non_goals: Do not spawn sessions in this task.
Do not replace roadmap tasks with daemon jobs.
Do not rename roadmap helper modules.

notes: Reviewed cloned Urbis and OpenClaw repositories plus local runtime research before shaping the model. Useful borrowed ideas: Urbis-style small durable records + append-only activity evidence, and OpenClaw/Hermes-style task/run separation, graph-backed lifecycle, heartbeats, blocks, retries, and explicit handoff refs.
Reviewed system diagrams and file structure; updated data-model, state-lifecycle, component-map, and file-structure-map so daemon jobs are visible and not hidden behind docs-only prose.
No session spawning or dispatcher implementation added; TASK-063 remains schema/lifecycle/storage-boundary slice only.
